messages:
alex_k: Heads up — master is red on the linux Bazel matrix. Failing during toolchain selection: 'No matching toolchains found for types @rules_cc//cc:toolchain_type'. Full snippet:
```
ERROR: No matching toolchains found for types '@rules_cc//cc:toolchain_type'
INFO: Affected target: //examples/server:binary


INFO: Call stack:
  in cc_library rule //third_party/lib:helper (BUILD:12)
```

ci-bot: buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/bazel-linux/builds/4523#log-1234 (job: bazel-linux-x86_64) — failed. Rerun available :repeat:

maria_g: Is this a regression or infra image change? Last green was commit a1b2c3 (yesterday). I think someone bumped the gcc image in infra/ci-images.

samir: Quick guess: platform constraints changed (gcc label). Try `bazel query 'labels("toolchain", //:all)'` or check `WORKSPACE` for cc_toolchain_suite mappings. On CI the image probably no longer provides the expected toolchain target.

alex_k: I reproduced locally in an ubuntu:20.04 container with gcc-12 and build succeeds. On CI the failure is in the musl container (linux-musl-x86_64). Suspect the musl image lost its registered cc toolchain.

maria_g: @samir can you bisect the infra-image commits or at least check the merged PRs that touched ci-images/docker/gcc-*? If it's an infra bump we should revert the image for the linux-musl job ASAP.

samir: On it. Quick experiment: forcing `--platforms=@platforms//:linux_x86_64` didn't help. I tried a local minimal change to WORKSPACE to explicitly register the toolchain and `cc_toolchain_suite` mapping, and that made the build pass locally. Patch diff (conceptual):
```diff
diff --git a/WORKSPACE b/WORKSPACE
+register_toolchains("//third_party/toolchains:gcc_11_toolchain")
+register_toolchains("//third_party/toolchains:gcc_musl_toolchain")
```

alex_k: Can you open a quick hotfix PR that pins the linux-musl job to the older image or adds the explicit register_toolchains mapping? If we get CI green we can do a proper follow-up to reconcile toolchain labels. I'll trigger the rerun once PR is up. Tag eng-infra for review.

samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/789 — adds explicit register_toolchains and pins musl image to gcc-11. Commit abcdef. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: Re-run triggered: https://buildkite.com/redwood/bazel-linux/builds/4524#log-5678 — jobs queued.

jen: Also seeing intermittent failures in `//tests:linker_test` on that same matrix. Could be related to the toolchain change or a separate flaky test. Noting here so we don't ignore it.

maria_g: :eyes: Monitoring the new run. If it passes we'll merge the hotfix and follow up with infra to update images and toolchain labels cleanly. Thanks for the quick triage everyone.
